The '''House of War''' was a building located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It was connected to the [[High Priest House]], the [[Priest House]], and the [[Audience Hall]]. The building was the residence of the [[bishop of war]], and was filled with weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] decorations.<ref name="BGS" />
